recommendation: Keep the commit. If Transport returns to core or a current replacement is selected, Patient Care/O&O should make a separate decision and regenerate any CarePlan diagrams from the authoritative StructureDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-39101 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to remove CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and change CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference to support CommunicationRequest, CoverageEligibilityRequest, RequestOrchestration, and Transport.
initial_application: The Jira-linked commit 0222d171b0466cb633dce3342278e3da94cfd815 commented out plannedActivityDetail, the cpl-3 mutual-exclusion condition, and plannedActivityDetail search parameters, and converted examples toward plannedActivityReference/contained request usage. It left CoverageEligibilityRequest and Transport out of the plannedActivityReference targetProfile list, while CommunicationRequest and RequestOrchestration are present in current source.
additional_context: CarePlan and CoverageEligibilityRequest are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Transport still has residual source files and metadata but is absent from the active [resources] list after later OO resource removal work, so adding it back as a core targetProfile would contradict current build scope. FHIR-31407 is a duplicate/background issue that supplied the consistency rationale for removing the inline activity detail backbone.
reconciliation: Updated source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml to include J#39101 in the plannedActivityReference committee notes and to add http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/CoverageEligibilityRequest as a targetProfile. No generated-looking SVG was hand-edited; the authoritative StructureDefinition is the build-scope source for the resource definition, and the existing SVG already contains unrelated stale target-list entries from later source removals.
